cases.note: Known limit on this Mac (2026-09-22): Chrome's profile picker window ('Who's using Chrome?') was open and is Chrome's key window, so AXPress on File › New Tab, ⌘T through the HID tap, and the strip's + button all left the tab count at 17. Re-run with the picker closed; when it passes, untag expected_fail. The executor now falls back from AXPress to the item's own shortcut and verifies new/closed tabs by the strip's tab count.
